visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a brightly lit entrance of a restaurant. A teal-green sign above the entrance displays 'PALE JADE PAVILION TAIWANESE CUISINE' and '白玉樓' in white and pink lettering. A female server wearing a face mask and a light-colored vest is partially visible on the left side of the frame. (2) The camera pans upward to show a large, multi-tiered crystal chandelier hanging from a dark ceiling, surrounded by several smaller spotlights. The background features a textured wall with earthy tones and blurred figures of customers dining at tables. (3) A wide shot displays a table full of various Taiwanese dishes on a dark grey surface. Bowls of white rice, steamed eggs with shrimp, and plates of fried chicken are visible. A hand reaches into the frame to move one of the small appetizer bowls. (4) A close-up focus shot highlights a plate of crispy fried chicken pieces mixed with numerous bright red dried chilies and chopped green scallions. The dish sits next to a white bowl of soup on the textured tabletop. (5) Sliced fried fish or egg rolls are shown in a white hexagonal bowl. A pair of chopsticks picks up one slice, revealing a dense, light-colored interior, and dips it into a small white saucer containing a red sauce. (6) A large portion of steamed egg is lifted with a spoon, showing a topping of peeled shrimp, sliced red chilies, and green scallions in a savory brown sauce. The egg appears soft and moist under the indoor lighting. (7) Chopsticks grab pieces of glistening braised pork belly from a white plate. The pork cubes are mixed with fresh scallion sections, and the surface of the meat reflects the bright overhead lights. (8) A single golden-brown fried chicken wing is held up by chopsticks against the background of other dishes. The texture of the crispy skin is clearly visible in the close-up shot. (9) A spoon scoops out pieces of meat and scallions from a steaming white bowl of soup. Another shot follows, showing a different soup containing large white garlic cloves, clams, and chicken pieces in a clear broth. (10) Two desserts are presented: a fried taro roll with a yellow center and a clear glass bowl of white fungus soup decorated with goji berries and a red date. A silver spoon rests in the sweet soup. (11) A glass teapot with a red 'HUA TAI' label is seen, followed by a shot of hot milk tea being poured into a small white ceramic cup. The tea is a smooth, light-brown color. (12) The final scene pans through the restaurant interior, showing empty tables with grey chairs, teal-green walls with mirrors, and multiple gold-colored pendant lamps hanging from the ceiling.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: PALE JADE PAVILION TAIWANESE CUISINE 白玉樓. [Subtitle]: 如果你逛夢時代也會餓. (2) [Subtitle]: 這間台菜店要筆記起來. (3) [Subtitle]: 一個人或一群人. (4) [Subtitle]: 想怎麼吃都可以. (5) [Subtitle]: 這次點的是雙人套餐. (6) [Subtitle]: 有六道餐點和兩樣甜點. (7) [Subtitle]: 炸魚卵酥香好吃. (8) [Subtitle]: 可以搭配五味醬或美乃滋. (9) [Subtitle]: 剝皮辣椒蝦仁滑蛋. (10) [Subtitle]: 軟嫩帶點辣. (11) [Subtitle]: 蒜苗五花肉煸得焦香. (12) [Subtitle]: 真的超下飯. (13) [Subtitle]: 椒麻雞翅吃起來外酥裡嫩. (14) [Subtitle]: 湯品干貝豬肚雞. (15) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭蜆仔雞. (16) [Subtitle]: 料都給得很實在. (17) [Subtitle]: 甜點有芋棗. (18) [Subtitle]: 桂花銀耳湯. (19) [Subtitle]: 不膩口 剛好收個味. (20) [Subtitle]: 推薦加點熱奶茶. (21) [Subtitle]: 是用百年茶廠的茶葉. (22) [Subtitle]: 味道濃厚好喝. (23) [Subtitle]: 這裡也有適合一人用餐的菜色. (24) [Subtitle]: 多人聚餐就點澎派的桌菜. [Slogan]: 白玉樓 新譚經典台菜 夢時代店 高雄市前鎮區中華五路789號6樓(夢時代藍鯨館6F). (25) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (26) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
